summary: The existing production-capacity-planning skill is too specific to the 30hr/day MIG weld variant. This task revealed a returns center variant with 32hr/day capacity, multi-row demand summation, formula-based initial conditions, and queue-clearing step-down logic. Updated SKILL.md to add parameter discovery decision rules and anti-patterns for variant detection. Added variant-patterns.md reference documenting the returns center pattern as a reusable example.
